pharma.title: Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Secures CDSCO Approval for Generic Oral Semaglutide in India
pharma.summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories has obtained regulatory approval from the Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO) to introduce generic oral semaglutide in India.

pharma.title: Roche brings world’s 1st under-the-skin lung cancer drug to India
pharma.summary: Pharmaceutical major Roche introduced the world's first subcutaneous lung cancer injection to India, significantly reducing drug administration time to a 7-minute shot.

pharma.title: NPPA slaps Rs 4.92 crore demand notice on Natco Pharma for overcharging
pharma.summary: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) issued a demand notice of ₹4.92 crore to Natco Pharma for overcharging on regulated pharmaceutical products.

pharma.title: Indian Opioid Exports To Africa Raise Regulatory Concerns For New Delhi
pharma.summary: Concerns over Indian synthetic drug and opioid exports reaching West African markets have prompted regulatory review and heightened vigilance from New Delhi.

pharma.title: 12.4 Lakh Chemists Call May 20 Shutdown Against E-Pharmacies
pharma.summary: Over 12.4 lakh retail chemists across India announced a nationwide shutdown set for May 20 to protest against the operations of e-pharmacy platforms.

national.title: BRICS FMs Meet In Delhi Under India Chairship
national.summary: India hosted the BRICS Foreign Ministers' Meeting in New Delhi under its chairship to address global security, West Asian stability, and intra-bloc cooperation.

national.title: In first step after PM Modi's appeal, government raises gold, silver duty to 15%
national.summary: Following a national appeal to curb non-essential imports, the Union Government increased the import duty on gold and silver to 15%.

national.title: Delhi makes 2-day work from home mandatory for government employees
national.summary: The Delhi government mandated a two-day work-from-home rule for state government employees to support fuel conservation and reduce vehicular emissions.

national.title: India to invest over $20 bn in offshore energy mapping: Hardeep Singh Puri
national.summary: Union Minister Hardeep Singh Puri announced India's plan to invest more than $20 billion in offshore energy mapping to boost domestic energy production.

international.title: Iran, Trade, Taiwan On Cards As Trump Set To Meet Xi Jinping In Beijing
international.summary: US President Donald Trump met Chinese President Xi Jinping in Beijing for bilateral discussions focused on international trade, Taiwan, and the ongoing Iran conflict.

international.title: BRICS Foreign Ministers meet in India as Iran war, oil prices, internal divisions test bloc’s unity
international.summary: BRICS Foreign Ministers deliberated in India on rising crude oil prices and West Asian conflict dynamics, while Minister EAM S. Jaishankar reaffirmed India's support for a two-state solution for Palestine.

international.title: COVID's impact lingers, influencing world's response to hantavirus
international.summary: Global public health bodies are utilizing response protocols established during the COVID-19 pandemic to manage emerging viral threats like hantavirus.

economy.title: IMF warns Iran war disruptions are pushing global economy towards ‘adverse’ scenario
economy.summary: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) warned that global economic growth faces severe downside risks due to supply disruptions and elevated energy prices caused by the Iran conflict.

economy.title: RBI expected to hold rates in June despite rising inflation, H2 rate hike bets emerge
economy.summary: The Reserve Bank of India signaled potential fuel price revisions if oil prices stay elevated, while market analysts expect the central bank to keep benchmark repo rates unchanged in June.

economy.title: Empowered Committee meets in Jammu to boost MSME sector
economy.summary: An Empowered Committee convened a meeting in Jammu to evaluate administrative and financial strategies aimed at boosting Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs).

science.title: RSC journals open to 18 million researchers through India’s ONOS scheme
science.summary: Royal Society of Chemistry (RSC) academic journals have been made available to over 18 million Indian researchers under the One Nation One Subscription (ONOS) initiative.

science.title: AMED, DST, and ICMR sign Memorandum of Cooperation on research collaboration
science.summary: India's Department of Science and Technology (DST) and Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) partnered with Japan's AMED to enhance joint medical research initiatives.

science.title: India Gets Its First Alzheimer’s Drug: Know All About Eli Lilly’s Lormalzi
science.summary: India approved its first targeted drug for Alzheimer's disease, Lormalzi, developed by global pharmaceutical firm Eli Lilly.

environment.title: Union Ministry of Environment asks Maharashtra government to examine complaints
environment.summary: The Union Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change directed the Maharashtra state government to investigate local environmental violation complaints.

environment.title: Dust storms and lightning kill at least 96 people in northern India
environment.summary: Severe pre-monsoon severe weather events including high-velocity dust storms and lightning strikes resulted in at least 96 casualties across northern India.

sports.title: Premier League brings NEXTGEN coach initiative to India
sports.summary: The English Premier League introduced its NEXTGEN coaching development program to India to elevate grassroots football training standard.

sports.title: Khalid Jamil Announces India’s Preliminary Squad for Unity Cup 2026
sports.summary: Indian national football team coach Khalid Jamil announced the preliminary squad selection for the upcoming Unity Cup 2026 tournament.

awards_honours.title: Yellowings Wins Prestigious LEAPS 2025 Award
awards_honours.summary: Logistics service provider Yellowings emerged as the sole Indian honouree in the Logistics Operations Service Providers category at the LEAPS 2025 Awards.

awards_honours.title: Taylor Swift and Sabrina Carpenter win top songwriting honour at BMI Awards
awards_honours.summary: Popular artists Taylor Swift and Sabrina Carpenter were recognized with top songwriting honors at the annual BMI Pop Awards.

defence.title: UAE Eyeing Big Defence Pact And Stronger Security Ties With India
defence.summary: The United Arab Emirates is seeking to establish a comprehensive defence and security alliance with India amidst shifting geopolitical developments in West Asia.

schemes_appointments.title: Former RBI Deputy Governor R Gandhi appointed chairman of Sahamati
schemes_appointments.summary: Former RBI Deputy Governor R. Gandhi was appointed as the Chairman of Sahamati, the collective self-regulatory organization for India's Account Aggregator network.

schemes_appointments.title: HDB Financial Services Appoints N Srinivasan Chairman
schemes_appointments.summary: Non-banking financial company HDB Financial Services appointed N. Srinivasan as its new Chairman.

schemes_appointments.title: New Bharat e-Charge App Could Simplify EV Charging in India
schemes_appointments.summary: The newly introduced 'Bharat e-Charge' mobile application aims to consolidate and streamline access to electric vehicle (EV) charging stations nationwide.

important_days.title: World Pest Day theme announced: Defending health across borders
important_days.summary: World Pest Day announced its focus area and global theme centered around safeguarding public health and disease vector prevention across international borders.

important_days.title: International Day of Plant Health Observed
important_days.summary: The International Day of Plant Health was observed globally to raise awareness regarding plant protection, agricultural sustainability, and ecosystem safety.

mcqs.q: Under which scheme are Royal Society of Chemistry (RSC) journals being made accessible to over 18 million researchers in India?
mcqs.explanation: Royal Society of Chemistry (RSC) journals were opened to over 18 million researchers in India through the government's One Nation One Subscription (ONOS) scheme.

mcqs.q: Which pharmaceutical company recently obtained CDSCO approval for launching generic oral semaglutide in India?
mcqs.explanation: Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories secured regulatory approval from the CDSCO for generic oral semaglutide in India.

mcqs.q: Who among the following was appointed as the Chairman of Sahamati in May 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Former Reserve Bank of India Deputy Governor R. Gandhi was appointed as the Chairman of Sahamati.

mcqs.q: In May 2026, the Indian government increased the import duty on gold and silver to what level?
mcqs.explanation: Following an appeal to reduce non-essential imports, the Indian government raised the import duty on gold and silver to 15%.

mcqs.q: Which organization was recognized as India's sole honouree in the Logistics Operations Service Providers category at the LEAPS 2025 Awards?
mcqs.explanation: Yellowings won the LEAPS 2025 Award as India's sole honouree in the Logistics Operations Service Providers category.
